---
title: "MiSTer Controller Latency"
author: "Porkchop Express, Lemonici"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

<style>
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap");

:root {
  --bg: #32008d;
  --bg-accent-a: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.28);
  --bg-accent-b: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --text: #f3edff;
  --muted: #d8c9ff;
  --card: rgba(34, 14, 92, 0.72);
  --card-solid: rgba(29, 12, 80, 0.92);
  --panel: rgba(41, 16, 110, 0.72);
  --border: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.2);
  --border-strong: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.42);
  --tab-idle: #ecdeff;
  --shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(17, 3, 48, 0.45);
  --shadow-soft: 0 6px 20px rgba(11, 2, 34, 0.38);
  --ring: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.38);
  --primary: #5000DC;
  --primary-strong: #6f2cff;
  --accent: #E6FF1E;
  --accent-strong: #f3ff74;
  --cta: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6FF1E 0%, #bfd900 100%);
  --chip-bg: rgba(38, 14, 101, 0.86);
  --chip-border: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.22);
  --table-row: rgba(39, 16, 103, 0.8);
  --plot-bg: #2b0a78;
  --header-grad: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.22), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08));
  --mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
}

html[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #3f1e8f;
  --bg-accent-a: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.24);
  --bg-accent-b: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --text: #f4efff;
  --muted: #d5c9ff;
  --card: rgba(21, 8, 56, 0.9);
  --card-solid: #1a0b45;
  --panel: rgba(23, 9, 62, 0.9);
  --border: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.24);
  --border-strong: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.44);
  --tab-idle: #e7dcff;
  --shadow: 0 22px 55px rgba(8, 2, 24, 0.58);
  --shadow-soft: 0 10px 28px rgba(7, 2, 18, 0.46);
  --ring: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.45);
  --primary: #a783ff;
  --primary-strong: #c2a9ff;
  --accent: #E6FF1E;
  --accent-strong: #f7ff9a;
  --cta: linear-gradient(135deg, #E6FF1E 0%, #c2db00 100%);
  --chip-bg: rgba(28, 11, 73, 0.94);
  --chip-border: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.25);
  --table-row: rgba(25, 10, 66, 0.9);
  --plot-bg: #1f0c52;
  --header-grad: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.24), rgba(123, 75, 255, 0.16));
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  font-family: "Space Grotesk", "Segoe UI", "Trebuchet MS", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease;
}

body::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(1200px 540px at 10% -5%, var(--bg-accent-a), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 98% 0%, var(--bg-accent-b), transparent 62%);
  z-index: -1;
}

a {
  color: var(--accent);
}

a:hover {
  color: var(--accent-strong);
}

.main-container {
  max-width: 1580px !important;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  padding: 20px 20px 28px;
}

#TOC {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 10px !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
  background: var(--panel) !important;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft) !important;
}

div.tocify {
  position: sticky !important;
  top: 10px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 320px !important;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 24px) !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  margin-left: 0 !important;
}

.tocify .tocify-header,
.tocify .tocify-item {
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
}

.tocify .list-group-item {
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  padding: 8px 10px !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  color: var(--muted) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.tocify .list-group-item:hover {
  background: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.12) !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
  border-color: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.34) !important;
}

.tocify .list-group-item.active,
.tocify .list-group-item.active:hover,
.tocify .list-group-item.active:focus {
  color: var(--text) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.2), rgba(123, 75, 255, 0.22)) !important;
  border-color: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.38) !important;
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent);
}

.tocify-subheader .list-group-item {
  font-size: 0.92rem !important;
  padding-left: 16px !important;
}

#header {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: var(--header-grad);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  padding: 28px 24px 22px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

#header h1.title {
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 2.2vw, 2.45rem);
}

#header .author {
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.tab-content > .tab-pane {
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.nav-tabs {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.nav-tabs > li > a {
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0;
  color: var(--tab-idle);
  transition: background 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.nav-tabs > li > a:hover {
  background: var(--panel);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.nav-tabs > li.active > a,
.nav-tabs > li.active > a:hover,
.nav-tabs > li.active > a:focus {
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--card);
  border-color: var(--border);
  border-bottom-color: transparent;
}

.bg-source-note {
  margin: 4px 0 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--panel);
  color: var(--muted);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.bg-hero {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 16px 14px;
  margin: 6px 0 18px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.16), rgba(80, 0, 220, 0.16)),
    var(--panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.bg-hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.12rem, 2vw, 1.42rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text);
  margin-bottom: 3px;
}

.bg-hero-sub {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.94rem;
}

.bg-hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.bg-hero-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.4);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #2a2d07;
  background: var(--accent);
}

.bg-hero-btn:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
  border-color: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.62);
  background: var(--accent-strong);
}

.bg-hero-meta {
  margin-top: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.bg-hero-meta span {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  background: var(--card-solid);
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

.bg-kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 8px 0 18px;
}

.bg-kpi {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: var(--panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
}

.bg-kpi .label {
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.bg-kpi .value {
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.bg-filter-panel {
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 24px 24px 20px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter: blur(7px);
}

.bg-filter-panel h4 {
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.bg-filter-group {
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.bg-filter-group:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.bg-filter-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(230px, 1fr) auto auto auto auto auto;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  align-items: center;
}

.bg-filter-search {
  min-width: 0;
}

.bg-filter-search input,
.bg-filter-sort select,
.bg-density-btn,
.bg-theme-btn,
.bg-reset-btn {
  min-height: 42px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--card-solid);
  color: var(--text);
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
}

.bg-filter-search input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 0.94rem;
}

.bg-filter-search input:focus,
.bg-filter-sort select:focus,
.bg-density-btn:focus,
.bg-theme-btn:focus,
.bg-reset-btn:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ring);
}

.bg-filter-sort select {
  padding: 8px 10px;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.bg-density-btn,
.bg-theme-btn,
.bg-reset-btn {
  padding: 9px 12px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.bg-density-btn:hover,
.bg-theme-btn:hover,
.bg-reset-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.filter-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  margin: 4px 6px 4px 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--card-solid);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.filter-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--panel);
}

.filter-btn.active {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #2a2d07;
  border-color: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.72);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.25);
}

.filter-btn.active[data-dim="category"] { background: var(--accent); }
.filter-btn.active[data-dim="connection"] {
  background: var(--accent-strong);
  color: #2a2d07;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.3);
}
.filter-btn.active[data-dim="platform"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--primary-strong));
  color: #f7f7ff;
}
.filter-btn.active[data-dim="face"],
.filter-btn.active[data-dim="home"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-strong));
  color: #2a2d07;
}
.filter-btn.active[data-dim="analog"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #bdf100);
  color: #2a2d07;
}

.bg-counter {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  font-family: var(--mono);
}

.bg-recent-strip {
  display: flex;
  overflow-x: auto;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 4px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.bg-recent-strip::-webkit-scrollbar {
  height: 6px;
}

.bg-recent-strip::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.bg-recent-chip {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: var(--chip-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--chip-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--text);
}

.bg-recent-chip .chip-badge {
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.bg-card-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.bg-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 16px 18px 14px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft);
  transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  grid-template-areas:
    "rank title metrics"
    "rank mode mode"
    "rank meter meter"
    "rank buy buy"
    "rank details details";
  column-gap: 14px;
  row-gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(8px);
  animation: cardReveal 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--stagger, 0) * 28ms);
}

.bg-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--primary-strong));
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.bg-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

@keyframes cardReveal {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.bg-card-rank {
  grid-area: rank;
  align-self: start;
  padding-top: 2px;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.bg-card-title {
  grid-area: title;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.bg-card-name {
  font-size: 1.36rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text);
  line-height: 1.35;
  min-width: 0;
}

.bg-card-connection-badge {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.bg-card-metrics {
  grid-area: metrics;
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 1.34rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.bg-card-mode {
  grid-area: mode;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-top: -3px;
}

.bg-metric-sep {
  color: var(--muted);
  margin: 0 0.28em;
}

.bg-card-probability {
  grid-area: meter;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.bg-prob-track {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.16);
}

.bg-prob-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.bg-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.35;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}

.bg-tag-tier-a { background: rgba(35, 167, 102, 0.16); color: #0a7d49; border-color: rgba(35, 167, 102, 0.35); }
.bg-tag-tier-b { background: rgba(235, 167, 42, 0.16); color: #9b6200; border-color: rgba(235, 167, 42, 0.35); }
.bg-tag-tier-c { background: rgba(231, 84, 84, 0.16); color: #b23a3a; border-color: rgba(231, 84, 84, 0.35); }
.bg-tag-category { background: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.2); color: #2a2d07; border-color: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.46); }
.bg-tag-connection { background: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.2); color: #2a2d07; border-color: rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.46); }
.bg-tag-platform { background: rgba(99, 117, 146, 0.14); color: #2f3b4f; border-color: rgba(99, 117, 146, 0.3); font-weight: 600; }

html[data-theme="dark"] .bg-tag-tier-a { color: #8be5bc; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .bg-tag-tier-b { color: #f2d28a; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .bg-tag-tier-c { color: #ffb6b6; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .bg-tag-category { color: #2a2d07; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .bg-tag-connection { color: #2a2d07; }
html[data-theme="dark"] .bg-tag-platform { color: #c5d1e8; }

.bg-card-actions {
  grid-area: buy;
  margin-top: 2px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
}

.bg-card-details-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--card-solid);
  color: var(--text);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.bg-card-details-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.bg-card-actions .bg-card-buy {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.bg-card-link a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--card-solid);
  color: var(--text);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.bg-card-link a:hover {
  text-decoration: none;
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}

.bg-card-buy a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 9px 14px;
  background: var(--cta);
  color: #2a2d07;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(230, 255, 30, 0.28);
}

.bg-card-buy a:hover {
  color: #2a2d07;
  text-decoration: none;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.bg-card-details {
  grid-area: details;
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--panel);
  padding: 10px 10px 8px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.bg-card-details-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.bg-card-detail-link {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: none;
}

.bg-variant-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.bg-variant-row {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--card);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.bg-variant-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.bg-variant-mode {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--text);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.bg-variant-values {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.bg-variant-bar-track {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: rgba(99, 117, 146, 0.14);
}

.bg-variant-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  min-width: 4px;
}

.bg-variant-meta {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.dataTables_wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--text);
}

.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter input,
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length select {
  background: var(--card-solid);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_info,
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate {

```{r theme-bootstrap, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
htmltools::HTML('
<script>
(function() {
  var THEME_KEY = "inputlatency-theme";
  var DENSITY_KEY = "inputlatency-density";
  var saved = null;
  try { saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY); } catch (e) {}
  var prefersDark = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  var theme = saved || (prefersDark ? "dark" : "light");
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);

  var density = "comfortable";
  try {
    var storedDensity = localStorage.getItem(DENSITY_KEY);
    if (storedDensity === "comfortable" || storedDensity === "compact") {
      density = storedDensity;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-density", density);
})();
</script>
')
```

```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gsheet)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# Helper function to truncate long device names
truncate_name <- function(name, max_chars = 40) {
  ifelse(nchar(name) > max_chars,
         paste0(substr(name, 1, max_chars - 3), "..."),
         name)
}

normalize_device_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("&", " and ") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_squish()
}

make_device_slug <- function(x) {
  normalize_device_name(x) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(" ", "-")
}

# Color palettes for consistent styling
connection_colors <- c(
  "Wired" = "#A8BE00",
  "Wireless" = "#5000DC"
)

category_colors <- c(
  "Arcade Stick" = "#5000DC",
  "Controller" = "#6A2DF0",
  "Adapter" = "#9BB000",
  "Arcade Encoder" = "#C6DD00",
  "Gamepad" = "#7D4DE2",
  "Flight Stick" = "#705600",
  "Racing Wheel" = "#2E215A",
  "Other" = "#7A8499"
)

wireless_type_colors <- c(
  "Bluetooth" = "#5000DC",
  "2.4 GHz" = "#A8BE00"
)
```

```{r load-gsheet-data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KlRObr3Be4zLch7Zyqg6qCJzGuhyGmXaOIUrpfncXIM/edit#gid=0"
cache_csv <- "../results/latency_sheet_cache.csv"
data_source <- "live"
data_source_label <- "Google Sheet (live)"
data_source_cached_at <- as.POSIXct(NA)
fetch_error <- NA_character_

dat_raw <- tryCatch({
  gsheet2tbl(sheet_url)
}, error = function(e) {
  fetch_error <<- conditionMessage(e)
  NULL
})

if (!is.null(dat_raw) && nrow(dat_raw) > 0) {
  write.csv(dat_raw, cache_csv, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  if (file.exists(cache_csv)) {
    data_source_cached_at <- as.POSIXct(file.info(cache_csv)$mtime)
  }
} else if (file.exists(cache_csv)) {
  dat_raw <- read.csv(cache_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
  data_source <- "cache"
  data_source_label <- "Local cache (fallback)"
  data_source_cached_at <- as.POSIXct(file.info(cache_csv)$mtime)
  message("Using cached latency dataset from: ", format(data_source_cached_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"))
} else {
  stop(
    "Unable to load data from Google Sheets and no cache file exists at ", cache_csv,
    ". Last error: ", fetch_error
  )
}

if (!"Latency Tier" %in% names(dat_raw) && "Tier" %in% names(dat_raw)) {
  dat_raw$`Latency Tier` <- dat_raw$Tier
}

# Ensure schema compatibility across sheet revisions / cache snapshots
required_cols <- c(
  "Make", "Model", "Device", "Link", "Connection", "Wired / Wireless",
  "Wireless Connection", "Home Button", "Latency Tier",
  "Average Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Standard Deviation of Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Max Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Min Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Category", "Face Buttons", "Date Added", "Valid Results"
)
for (col in required_cols) {
  if (!col %in% names(dat_raw)) {
    dat_raw[[col]] <- NA
  }
}

numeric_cols <- c(
  "Average Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Standard Deviation of Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Max Measured Latency (in ms)",
  "Min Measured Latency (in ms)"
)
for (col in intersect(numeric_cols, names(dat_raw))) {
  dat_raw[[col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", dat_raw[[col]])))
}

dat <- dat_raw %>%
  mutate(Row = 2:(nrow(dat_raw) + 1)) %>%
  filter(toupper(as.character(`Valid Results`)) %in% c("YES", "TRUE", "1")) %>%
  select(
    Make, Model, Device, Link, Connection,
    "Wired/Wireless" = `Wired / Wireless`,
    "WirelessConnection" = `Wireless Connection`,
    `Home Button`,
    `Latency Tier`,
    "Latency (in ms)" = `Average Measured Latency (in ms)`,
    "SD" = `Standard Deviation of Measured Latency (in ms)`,
    "Max" = `Max Measured Latency (in ms)`,
    "Min" = `Min Measured Latency (in ms)`,
    Category, `Face Buttons`, Row, `Date Added`,
    Amazon = any_of("Amazon"),
    Price = any_of("Price"),
    any_of(c("MiSTer / PC", "Switch", "PS4", "PS5", "Xbox One", "Xbox Series"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Latency (in ms)`)) %>%
  arrange(`Latency (in ms)`) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = row_number(),
    DeviceClean = Device,
    DeviceNorm = normalize_device_name(DeviceClean),
    Device = ifelse(is.na(Link),
                    Device,
                    paste0('<a target=_blank href="', Link, '">', Device, '</a>'))
  ) %>%
  distinct(DeviceClean, Connection, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(`Latency (in ms)`)

# Build Platforms list-column from platform columns if they exist
platform_cols <- intersect(c("MiSTer / PC", "Switch", "PS4", "PS5", "Xbox One", "Xbox Series"), names(dat))
if (length(platform_cols) > 0) {
  dat$Platforms <- apply(dat[, platform_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(row) {
    cols <- platform_cols[!is.na(row) & trimws(toupper(row)) %in% c("YES", "TRUE", "X", "1")]
    paste(cols, collapse = ",")
  })
} else {
  dat$Platforms <- ""
}

# Clean Price column if it exists
if ("Price" %in% names(dat)) {
  dat$PriceNum <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", dat$Price))
} else {
  dat$Price <- NA_character_
  dat$PriceNum <- NA_real_
}

# Ensure Amazon column exists
if (!"Amazon" %in% names(dat)) {
  dat$Amazon <- NA_character_
}

# Convert Excel serial dates to mm/dd/YYYY when needed (cache fallback compatibility)
if ("Date Added" %in% names(dat)) {
  serial_dates <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dat$`Date Added`))
  needs_serial_parse <- !is.na(serial_dates) & !grepl("/", dat$`Date Added`)
  if (any(needs_serial_parse, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    dat$`Date Added`[needs_serial_parse] <- format(
      as.Date(serial_dates[needs_serial_parse], origin = "1899-12-30"),
      "%m/%d/%Y"
    )
  }
}
```

```{r load-csv-data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load raw CSV captures for detailed analysis
csv_dir <- "../captures/"
csv_files <- list.files(csv_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

load_csv_with_device <- function(file_path) {
  device_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  tryCatch({
    df <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (ncol(df) >= 2) {
      colnames(df)[1:2] <- c("read", "delay")
      df$Device <- device_name
      df <- df %>% select(Device, read, delay)
      return(df)
    }
    return(NULL)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

raw_data <- lapply(csv_files, load_csv_with_device) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  filter(!is.na(delay)) %>%
  mutate(DeviceNorm = normalize_device_name(Device))

frame_ms <- 100 / 6

same_frame_from_samples <- function(delay_ms, frame_window_ms = frame_ms) {
  mean(pmax(0, 1 - delay_ms / frame_window_ms), na.rm = TRUE) * 100
}

same_frame_from_normal <- function(mu, sigma, frame_window_ms = frame_ms) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(mu))

  valid <- !is.na(mu) & !is.na(sigma) & sigma > 0
  if (any(valid)) {
    z <- (frame_window_ms - mu[valid]) / sigma[valid]
    out[valid] <- (((frame_window_ms - mu[valid]) * pnorm(z)) + sigma[valid] * dnorm(z)) /
      frame_window_ms * 100
  }

  deterministic <- !is.na(mu) & (!is.na(sigma) & sigma <= 0)
  if (any(deterministic)) {
    out[deterministic] <- pmax(0, 1 - mu[deterministic] / frame_window_ms) * 100
  }

  fallback <- !is.na(mu) & is.na(out)
  if (any(fallback)) {
    out[fallback] <- pmax(0, 1 - mu[fallback] / frame_window_ms) * 100
  }

  out <- pmax(pmin(out, 100), 0)
  out
}

# Calculate percentile statistics from raw data
raw_stats <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(Device) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    RawMean = mean(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    RawSD = sd(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    P90 = quantile(delay, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    P95 = quantile(delay, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    P99 = quantile(delay, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    RawMin = min(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    RawMax = max(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    PctOnTime = round(same_frame_from_samples(delay), 1),
    BinA = round(sum(delay <= 100/6) / n() * 100, 1),
    BinB = round(sum(delay > 100/6 & delay <= 200/6) / n() * 100, 1),
    BinC = round(sum(delay > 200/6) / n() * 100, 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(Consistency = round(100 * (1 - RawSD / RawMean), 1))

if (nrow(raw_stats) > 0) {
  raw_device_index <- raw_stats %>%
    distinct(Device, RawMean) %>%
    arrange(RawMean, Device) %>%
    transmute(
      Device,
      DeviceNorm = normalize_device_name(Device)
    )
  raw_device_index$DeviceSlug <- make.unique(make_device_slug(raw_device_index$Device), sep = "-")
  raw_device_index$Tokens <- strsplit(raw_device_index$DeviceNorm, " ", fixed = TRUE)
} else {
  raw_device_index <- tibble::tibble(
    Device = character(0),
    DeviceNorm = character(0),
    DeviceSlug = character(0),
    Tokens = list()
  )
}

raw_stats_by_norm <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(DeviceNorm) %>%
  summarise(
    MatchedCaptureFiles = n_distinct(Device),
    N = n(),
    RawMean = mean(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    RawSD = sd(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    P90 = quantile(delay, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    P95 = quantile(delay, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    P99 = quantile(delay, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR = IQR(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    RawMin = min(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    RawMax = max(delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    PctOnTime = round(same_frame_from_samples(delay), 1),
    BinA = round(sum(delay <= 100/6) / n() * 100, 1),
    BinB = round(sum(delay > 100/6 & delay <= 200/6) / n() * 100, 1),
    BinC = round(sum(delay > 200/6) / n() * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Consistency = round(100 * (1 - RawSD / RawMean), 1))
```

```{r sd-imputation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# SD imputation via linear regression (restored from backup)
dat$Device <- factor(dat$Device, levels = unique(dat$Device))
fit <- lm(data = dat, SD ~ `Latency (in ms)` + Min)
dat$Imputed <- is.na(dat$SD)
dat$SD[dat$Imputed] <- pmax(predict.lm(fit, dat[dat$Imputed, ]), 0.1)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    `SD up` = `Latency (in ms)` + qnorm(.975) * SD,
    `SD down` = pmax(`Latency (in ms)` - qnorm(.975) * SD, 0)
  )

# Merge raw stats where available (normalized name matching)
dat <- dat %>%
  left_join(raw_stats_by_norm, by = "DeviceNorm")

# Estimate PctOnTime/bins for devices without raw CSV data using normal distribution
missing <- is.na(dat$PctOnTime)
dat$PctOnTime[missing] <- round(
  same_frame_from_normal(dat$`Latency (in ms)`[missing], dat$SD[missing]),
  1
)
dat$BinA[missing] <- round(pnorm(100/6, dat$`Latency (in ms)`[missing], dat$SD[missing]) * 100, 1)
dat$BinB[missing] <- round(
  (pnorm(200/6, dat$`Latency (in ms)`[missing], dat$SD[missing]) -
   pnorm(100/6, dat$`Latency (in ms)`[missing], dat$SD[missing])) * 100, 1)
dat$BinC[missing] <- round(100 - dat$BinA[missing] - dat$BinB[missing], 1)
# Clamp negatives
dat$BinA <- pmax(dat$BinA, 0)
dat$BinB <- pmax(dat$BinB, 0)
dat$BinC <- pmax(dat$BinC, 0)

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    HasRawCapture = !is.na(N),
    MetricSource = "Direct measurement"
  )

raw_unmatched <- raw_stats_by_norm %>%
  select(DeviceNorm, MatchedCaptureFiles) %>%
  left_join(
    raw_data %>% distinct(DeviceNorm, Device) %>% group_by(DeviceNorm) %>% summarise(
      CaptureExamples = paste(head(sort(unique(Device)), 3), collapse = "; "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ),
    by = "DeviceNorm"
  ) %>%
  anti_join(dat %>% distinct(DeviceNorm), by = "DeviceNorm") %>%
  arrange(desc(MatchedCaptureFiles), DeviceNorm)

sheet_without_raw <- dat %>%
  distinct(DeviceClean, DeviceNorm) %>%
  anti_join(raw_stats_by_norm %>% distinct(DeviceNorm), by = "DeviceNorm") %>%
  arrange(DeviceClean)

raw_coverage_pct <- ifelse(nrow(dat) > 0, round(mean(dat$HasRawCapture) * 100, 1), 0)

# Export derived datasets for maintenance workflows
write.csv(
  dat %>%
    mutate(
      `Latency (in ms)` = round(`Latency (in ms)`, 3),
      SD = round(SD, 3),
      PctOnTime = round(PctOnTime, 2)
    ),
  "../results/latency_cleaned_export.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

write.csv(
  raw_unmatched,
  "../results/raw_capture_unmatched.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

write.csv(
  sheet_without_raw,
  "../results/database_without_raw_capture.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

```{r buyers-guide-recent, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Recently Added strip ──────────────────────────────────
recent <- dat %>%
  mutate(DateParsed = as.Date(`Date Added`, format = "%m/%d/%Y")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(DateParsed)) %>%
  arrange(desc(DateParsed)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8)

if (nrow(recent) > 0) {
  h <- c('<h4 style="margin-bottom:12px;">Recently Added</h4>',
         '<div class="bg-recent-strip">')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(recent))) {
    r <- recent[i, ]
    lat <- round(r$`Latency (in ms)`, 2)
    tier_class <- if (lat < 100/6) "bg-tag-tier-a" else if (lat < 200/6) "bg-tag-tier-b" else "bg-tag-tier-c"
    h <- c(h, sprintf('<div class="bg-recent-chip"><span class="chip-badge %s">%.2f ms</span> %s</div>',
                       tier_class, lat, htmltools::htmlEscape(r$DeviceClean)))
  }
  h <- c(h, '</div>')
  htmltools::HTML(paste(h, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

```{r buyers-guide-filters, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
unique_non_empty <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  v <- stringr::str_squish(v)
  v <- v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(v) & v != "-" & tolower(v) != "na" & tolower(v) != "n/a"]
  sort(unique(v))
}
normalize_face_buttons_value <- function(x) {
  v <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  whole <- !is.na(num) & abs(num - round(num)) < 1e-9
  v[whole] <- as.character(as.integer(round(num[whole])))
  v
}

infer_analog_capability <- function(make, model, device_clean, category) {
  category_txt <- tolower(stringr::str_squish(as.character(category)))
  if (category_txt == "controller adapter") return("Depends on controller")
  if (category_txt %in% c("joystick", "joystick encoder")) return("No analog sticks")

  text <- tolower(stringr::str_squish(paste(make, model, device_clean, category)))
  yes_rx <- paste(
    "dualsense", "dualshock", "xbox", "switch\\s*pro", "wii\\s*u\\s*pro",
    "pro\\s*2", "elite", "pro\\s*controller", "f310", "f710",
    "wireless\\s+controller", "horipad", "brawlergen", sep = "|"
  )
  no_rx <- paste(
    "fighting\\s+commander", "fightpad", "fighting\\s+stick", "arcade\\s+stick",
    "classic", "nes", "snes", "genesis", "saturn", "neo-?geo", "pc\\s*engine",
    "6\\s*button", "astro\\s*city", "wii\\s*classic", sep = "|"
  )

  if (grepl(yes_rx, text, perl = TRUE)) return("Has analog sticks")
  if (grepl(no_rx, text, perl = TRUE)) return("No analog sticks")
  "Unknown"
}
```

```{r buyers-guide-cards, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Result cards (grouped by controller mode) ───────────────────────────────
frame_ms <- 100 / 6

fmt_pct_label <- function(pct) {
  if (abs(pct - round(pct)) < 0.05) sprintf("%.0f%%", round(pct)) else sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)
}

extract_mode_from_name <- function(x) {
  m <- stringr::str_match(x, "\\[(.+?)\\]")[, 2]
  ifelse(is.na(m), "", m)
}

is_generic_mode <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(stringr::str_squish(as.character(x)))
  if (!nzchar(x) || x %in% c("-", "?", "n/a", "na", "none", "default")) {
    return(TRUE)
  }

  generic_patterns <- c(
    "^wired$",
    "^wireless$",
    "^wired usb$",
    "^wired usb c$",
    "^wired usb a$",
    "^wireless usb$",
    "^usb$",
    "^usb c$",
    "^usb a$",
    "^wired connection$",
    "^wireless connection$"
  )

  any(stringr::str_detect(x, generic_patterns))
}

pick_mode_label <- function(mode_from_name, connection, wireless_connection) {
  candidates <- c(mode_from_name, connection, wireless_connection)
  candidates <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(candidates))
  candidates <- candidates[!is.na(candidates) & nzchar(candidates)]
  if (length(candidates) == 0) return("")

  non_generic <- candidates[!vapply(candidates, is_generic_mode, logical(1))]
  if (length(non_generic) == 0) "" else non_generic[[1]]
}

collapse_platforms <- function(x) {
  raw <- paste(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(x))], collapse = ",")
  if (!nzchar(raw)) return("")
  vals <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(raw, ",")))
  vals <- vals[nzchar(vals)]
  paste(sort(unique(vals)), collapse = ",")
}

safe_text <- function(x, fallback = "") {
  v <- as.character(x)
  v <- v[!is.na(v) & nzchar(trimws(v))]
  if (length(v) == 0) fallback else trimws(v[[1]])
}

collapse_distinct_values <- function(x) {
  vals <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & nzchar(vals) & vals != "-" & tolower(vals) != "na" & tolower(vals) != "n/a"]
  unique(vals)
}
if (!exists("analog_axis_col")) {
  analog_axis_col <- NA_character_
}

tokenize_for_match <- function(x) {
  out <- unlist(strsplit(normalize_device_name(x), " ", fixed = TRUE))
  out <- out[nzchar(out)]
  unique(out)
}

match_drop_tokens <- c(
  "controller", "gamepad", "adapter", "converter", "cable",
  "for", "the", "and", "to", "wired", "wireless", "usb",
  "mode", "input", "xinput", "dinput", "windows", "switch",
  "playstation", "xbox", "pc", "series", "model"
)

find_raw_device_for_group <- function(group_df) {
  if (!exists("raw_device_index") || nrow(raw_device_index) == 0) {
    return(list(Device = NA_character_, Slug = NA_character_))
  }

  group_norms <- unique(group_df$DeviceNorm)
  group_norms <- group_norms[!is.na(group_norms) & nzchar(trimws(group_norms))]
  exact_hits <- raw_device_index %>% filter(DeviceNorm %in% group_norms)
  if (nrow(exact_hits) > 0) {
    return(list(Device = exact_hits$Device[[1]], Slug = exact_hits$DeviceSlug[[1]]))
  }

  group_make <- safe_text(group_df$Make, "")
  group_model <- safe_text(group_df$Model, "")
  group_name <- safe_text(group_df$GroupName, safe_text(group_df$DeviceClean, ""))
  group_category <- tolower(safe_text(group_df$Category, ""))

  make_tokens <- tokenize_for_match(group_make)
  model_source <- if (nzchar(group_model)) group_model else group_name
  model_tokens <- tokenize_for_match(model_source)
  if (length(make_tokens) > 0) {
    model_tokens <- setdiff(model_tokens, make_tokens)
  }
  model_tokens <- setdiff(model_tokens, match_drop_tokens)
  if (length(model_tokens) == 0) {
    model_tokens <- setdiff(tokenize_for_match(group_name), c(make_tokens, match_drop_tokens))
  }
  if (length(model_tokens) == 0) {
    return(list(Device = NA_character_, Slug = NA_character_))
  }

  raw_tokens <- raw_device_index$Tokens
  make_match <- if (length(make_tokens) == 0) {
    rep(TRUE, nrow(raw_device_index))
  } else {
    vapply(raw_tokens, function(tok) any(tok %in% make_tokens), logical(1))
  }
  overlap <- vapply(raw_tokens, function(tok) sum(model_tokens %in% tok), integer(1))
  denom <- max(length(unique(model_tokens)), 1L)
  score <- overlap / denom

  # Avoid mapping controller rows to obvious adapter/encoder captures.
  raw_is_adapter <- stringr::str_detect(raw_device_index$DeviceNorm, "\\b(adapter|converter|encoder)\\b")
  group_is_adapter <- stringr::str_detect(group_category, "adapter|encoder")
  if (!group_is_adapter) {
    score[raw_is_adapter] <- pmax(score[raw_is_adapter] - 0.35, 0)
  }

  score[!make_match] <- 0
  best_idx <- which.max(score)
  if (!length(best_idx) || score[[best_idx]] < 0.7 || overlap[[best_idx]] < 2) {
    return(list(Device = NA_character_, Slug = NA_character_))
  }

  list(
    Device = raw_device_index$Device[[best_idx]],
    Slug = raw_device_index$DeviceSlug[[best_idx]]
  )
}

card_variants <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    GroupName = stringr::str_squish(paste(Make, Model)),
    GroupName = if_else(is.na(GroupName) | GroupName == "", DeviceClean, GroupName),
    ModeFromName = extract_mode_from_name(DeviceClean),
    ModeLabel = purrr::pmap_chr(
      list(ModeFromName, Connection, WirelessConnection),
      pick_mode_label
    ),
    GroupKey = normalize_device_name(paste(GroupName, `Wired/Wireless`, Category)),
    PctOnTimeSafe = pmax(
      0,
      pmin(
        ifelse(
          is.na(PctOnTime),
          pmax(0, (1 - (`Latency (in ms)` / frame_ms)) * 100),
          PctOnTime
        ),
        99.9
      )
    )
  )

group_splits <- split(card_variants, card_variants$GroupKey)
group_order <- names(sort(vapply(
  group_splits,
  function(g) min(g$`Latency (in ms)`, na.rm = TRUE),
  numeric(1)
)))
group_slug_map <- stats::setNames(make.unique(make_device_slug(group_order), sep = "-"), group_order)
scatter_rows <- list()

h <- c(
  '<section class="bg-controller-detail" id="bg-controller-detail" hidden>',
  '<div class="bg-controller-detail-head">',
  '<button class="bg-controller-detail-close" type="button" onclick="closeControllerPage()">Back to list</button>',
  '<div class="bg-controller-detail-title" id="bg-controller-detail-title"></div>',
  '<div class="bg-controller-detail-meta" id="bg-controller-detail-meta"></div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="bg-controller-detail-actions" id="bg-controller-detail-actions"></div>',
  '<div class="bg-controller-detail-body" id="bg-controller-detail-body"></div>',
  '</section>',
  '<div class="bg-card-grid" id="bg-card-grid">'
)

for (rank_idx in seq_along(group_order)) {
  key <- group_order[[rank_idx]]
  controller_slug <- group_slug_map[[key]]
  g <- group_splits[[key]] %>%
    arrange(`Latency (in ms)`, DeviceClean)
  d <- g[1, ]

  lat <- round(d$`Latency (in ms)`, 2)
  pct_ontime <- max(min(d$PctOnTimeSafe, 99.9), 0)
  ontime_label <- fmt_pct_label(pct_ontime)
  meter_color <- if (pct_ontime >= 90) "#24a86b" else if (pct_ontime >= 75) "#A8BE00" else if (pct_ontime >= 50) "#d98d2b" else "#d95656"

  cat_val <- safe_text(d$Category)
  conn_val <- safe_text(d$`Wired/Wireless`)
  platforms_str <- collapse_platforms(g$Platforms)
  group_name <- safe_text(d$GroupName, d$DeviceClean)
  best_mode <- safe_text(d$ModeLabel, "")
  mode_values <- as.character(g$ModeLabel)
  mode_values <- mode_values[!is.na(mode_values)]
  mode_values <- unique(stringr::str_squish(mode_values))
  mode_values <- mode_values[nzchar(mode_values)]
  mode_count <- length(mode_values)
  mode_line <- if (mode_count > 1 && nzchar(best_mode)) {
    sprintf("Best mode: %s (%d modes tested)", best_mode, mode_count)
  } else if (mode_count > 1) {
    sprintf("%d modes tested", mode_count)
  } else if (mode_count == 1) {
    sprintf("Mode: %s", mode_values[[1]])
  } else {
    ""
  }

  face_values <- collapse_distinct_values(g$`Face Buttons`)
  if (length(face_values) > 0) {
    face_values <- unique(normalize_face_buttons_value(face_values))
  }
  home_values <- collapse_distinct_values(g$`Home Button`)
  analog_values <- if (!is.na(analog_axis_col) && analog_axis_col %in% names(g)) {
    collapse_distinct_values(g[[analog_axis_col]])
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
  face_attr <- paste(face_values, collapse = "|")
  home_attr <- paste(home_values, collapse = "|")
  analog_attr <- paste(analog_values, collapse = "|")
  face_label <- if (length(face_values) > 0) face_values[[1]] else ""
  home_label <- if (length(home_values) > 0) home_values[[1]] else ""
  analog_label <- if (length(analog_values) > 0) analog_values[[1]] else ""

  # Pick first available buy link among fastest variants.
  buy_url <- NA_character_
  controller_url <- NA_character_
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(g))) {
    amazon_j <- safe_text(g$Amazon[j], "")
    link_j <- safe_text(g$Link[j], "")
    if (is.na(controller_url) && nzchar(link_j)) {
      controller_url <- link_j
    }
    candidate <- if (nzchar(amazon_j)) amazon_j else if (nzchar(link_j)) link_j else ""
    if (nzchar(candidate)) {
      buy_url <- candidate
      break
    }
  }
  if (is.na(controller_url) && !is.na(buy_url) && nzchar(trimws(buy_url))) {
    controller_url <- buy_url
  }
  if (is.na(controller_url) || !nzchar(trimws(controller_url))) {
    query <- stringr::str_squish(paste(group_name, "controller"))
    if (nzchar(query)) {
      controller_url <- paste0("https://duckduckgo.com/?q=", utils::URLencode(query, reserved = TRUE))
    }
  }

  valid_prices <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(g$PriceNum))
  valid_prices <- valid_prices[is.finite(valid_prices) & valid_prices > 0]
  price_num <- if (length(valid_prices) > 0) min(valid_prices) else NA_real_
  price_attr <- ifelse(is.na(price_num), "", sprintf("%.2f", price_num))

  search_parts <- unique(c(
    g$DeviceClean, g$ModeLabel, g$Connection, g$WirelessConnection,
    g$Category, g$`Wired/Wireless`, g$Platforms, g$Make, g$Model,
    face_values, home_values, analog_values
  ))
  search_parts <- search_parts[!is.na(search_parts) & nzchar(trimws(search_parts))]
  search_blob <- tolower(paste(search_parts, collapse = " "))

  conn_badge_html <- if (nzchar(conn_val)) {
    sprintf(
      '<span class="bg-tag bg-tag-connection bg-card-connection-badge">%s</span>',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(conn_val)
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }

  buy_html <- if (!is.na(buy_url) && nzchar(trimws(buy_url))) {
    sprintf('<div class="bg-card-buy"><a href="%s" target="_blank">Buy &rarr;</a></div>',
            htmltools::htmlEscape(buy_url))
  } else {
    ""
  }

  controller_html <- if (!is.na(controller_url) && nzchar(trimws(controller_url))) {
    sprintf('<div class="bg-card-link"><a href="%s" target="_blank">Controller &uarr;</a></div>',
            htmltools::htmlEscape(controller_url))
  } else {
    ""
  }

  raw_match <- find_raw_device_for_group(g)
  raw_device_slug <- safe_text(raw_match$Slug, "")
  has_distribution <- nzchar(raw_device_slug)
  raw_target_text <- if (has_distribution) "Open Raw Distribution" else "Open Raw Deep Dive"
  raw_target_href <- if (has_distribution) {
    sprintf("#raw-dist-%s", raw_device_slug)
  } else {
    "#raw-data-deep-dive"
  }
  raw_target_onclick <- if (has_distribution) {
    sprintf("return openRawDistribution('%s');", raw_device_slug)
  } else {
    "return openTabSection('raw-data-deep-dive');"
  }

  open_page_btn <- sprintf(
    '<button class="bg-card-details-toggle" type="button" onclick="return openControllerPage(\'%s\');">Open page</button>',
    controller_slug
  )
  actions_html <- sprintf(
    '<div class="bg-card-actions">%s%s%s</div>',
    open_page_btn,
    controller_html,
    buy_html
  )

  detail_rows <- c(
    '<div class="bg-card-details">',
    '<div class="bg-card-details-header"><span>Mode-By-Mode Results</span></div>',
    '<div class="bg-variant-list">'
  )

  for (j in seq_len(nrow(g))) {
    v <- g[j, ]
    v_mode <- safe_text(v$ModeLabel, "")
    if (!nzchar(v_mode)) {
      v_wireless <- safe_text(v$WirelessConnection, "")
      v_mode <- if (nzchar(v_wireless) && !is_generic_mode(v_wireless)) v_wireless else "Measured result"
    }
    v_lat <- round(v$`Latency (in ms)`, 2)
    v_pct <- max(min(v$PctOnTimeSafe, 99.9), 0)
    v_sd <- if (!is.na(v$SD)) sprintf("SD %.2f", as.numeric(v$SD)) else "SD n/a"
    v_conn <- safe_text(v$Connection)
    if (tolower(v_conn) == tolower(v_mode) || is_generic_mode(v_conn)) {
      v_conn <- ""
    }
    v_platform <- safe_text(v$Platforms)
    meta_parts <- unique(c(v_conn, v_platform, v_sd))
    meta_parts <- meta_parts[nzchar(meta_parts)]
    v_meta <- paste(meta_parts, collapse = " | ")
    bar_width <- max(0, min(100, v_pct))
    bar_color <- if (v_pct >= 90) "#24a86b" else if (v_pct >= 75) "#A8BE00" else if (v_pct >= 50) "#d98d2b" else "#d95656"

    detail_rows <- c(detail_rows, sprintf(
      '<div class="bg-variant-row"><div class="bg-variant-head"><div class="bg-variant-mode">%s</div><div class="bg-variant-values">%.2fms<span class="bg-metric-sep">|</span>%s Same-Frame</div></div><div class="bg-variant-bar-track"><div class="bg-variant-bar-fill" style="width:%.1f%%;background:%s;"></div></div><div class="bg-variant-meta">%s</div></div>',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(v_mode),
      v_lat,
      fmt_pct_label(v_pct),
      bar_width,
      bar_color,
      htmltools::htmlEscape(v_meta)
    ))
  }

  detail_rows <- c(detail_rows, '</div></div>')
  details_html <- paste(detail_rows, collapse = "")
  details_template_html <- sprintf(
    '<template id="bg-controller-template-%s">%s</template>',
    controller_slug,
    details_html
  )
  card_anchor_html <- sprintf('<span class="bg-controller-anchor" id="controller-%s" hidden></span>', controller_slug)

  meter_html <- sprintf(
    '<div class="bg-card-probability"><div class="bg-prob-track"><div class="bg-prob-fill" style="width:%.1f%%;background:%s;"></div></div></div>',
    pct_ontime,
    meter_color
  )

  scatter_rows[[length(scatter_rows) + 1]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Slug = controller_slug,
    Device = group_name,
    Connection = conn_val,
    Category = cat_val,
    Latency = lat,
    SameFrame = pct_ontime,
    SD = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$SD)),
    RawSlug = raw_device_slug
  )

  h <- c(h, sprintf(
    '<div class="bg-card" data-controller-slug="%s" data-category="%s" data-connection="%s" data-platforms="%s" data-search="%s" data-latency="%.3f" data-ontime="%.3f" data-price="%s" data-face="%s" data-home="%s" data-analog="%s" data-controller-url="%s" data-buy-url="%s" data-raw-slug="%s" data-raw-target-href="%s" data-raw-target-onclick="%s" data-raw-target-text="%s">
<div class="bg-card-rank">#%d</div>
<div class="bg-card-title"><div class="bg-card-name">%s</div>%s</div>
<div class="bg-card-metrics">%.2fms<span class="bg-metric-sep">|</span>%s Same-Frame</div>
%s
%s
%s
%s
%s
%s%s%s
</div>',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(controller_slug),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(cat_val),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(conn_val),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(platforms_str),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(search_blob),
    lat,
    pct_ontime,
    price_attr,
    htmltools::htmlEscape(face_attr),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(home_attr),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(analog_attr),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(safe_text(controller_url, "")),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(safe_text(buy_url, "")),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(raw_device_slug),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(raw_target_href),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(raw_target_onclick),
    htmltools::htmlEscape(raw_target_text),
    rank_idx,
    htmltools::htmlEscape(group_name),
    conn_badge_html,
    lat,
    ontime_label,
    if (nzchar(face_label)) sprintf('<div class="bg-card-mode">Face Buttons: %s</div>', htmltools::htmlEscape(face_label)) else "",
    if (nzchar(home_label)) sprintf('<div class="bg-card-mode">Home Button: %s</div>', htmltools::htmlEscape(home_label)) else "",
    if (nzchar(analog_label) && !is.na(analog_axis_col)) sprintf('<div class="bg-card-mode">%s: %s</div>', htmltools::htmlEscape(analog_axis_col), htmltools::htmlEscape(analog_label)) else "",
    if (nzchar(mode_line)) sprintf('<div class="bg-card-mode">%s</div>', htmltools::htmlEscape(mode_line)) else "",
    meter_html,
    actions_html,
    card_anchor_html,
    details_template_html
  ))
}

h <- c(h, '</div>')  # close card grid
buyers_scatter_dat <- dplyr::bind_rows(scatter_rows)

htmltools::HTML(paste(h, collapse = "\n"))
```

<p class="bg-inline-note">Use <strong>Open page</strong> on any card for a shopper-focused controller profile, then jump directly to raw distribution when available.</p>

```{r buyers-guide-scatter, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (exists("buyers_scatter_dat") && nrow(buyers_scatter_dat) > 0) {
  scatter_df <- buyers_scatter_dat %>%
    mutate(
      SD = ifelse(is.na(SD), median(SD, na.rm = TRUE), SD),
      SD = ifelse(is.finite(SD), SD, 0.1),
      SameFrameLabel = ifelse(
        abs(SameFrame - round(SameFrame)) < 0.05,
        sprintf("%.0f%%", round(SameFrame)),
        sprintf("%.1f%%", SameFrame)
      ),
      HoverText = paste0(
        Device, "<br>",
        sprintf("Latency: %.2f ms", Latency), "<br>",
        sprintf("Same-frame: %s", SameFrameLabel), "<br>",
        "Connection: ", Connection, "<br>",
        "Category: ", Category
      )
    )

  p_buyer_scatter <- plot_ly(
    data = scatter_df,
    x = ~Latency,
    y = ~SameFrame,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    customdata = ~Slug,
    text = ~HoverText,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    color = ~Connection,
    colors = c("Wired" = "#A8BE00", "Wireless" = "#5000DC"),
    symbol = ~Category,
    symbols = c("circle", "diamond", "square", "triangle-up"),
    marker = list(
      sizemode = "diameter",
      sizeref = 0.4,
      line = list(width = 1, color = "rgba(16,22,34,0.35)")
    ),
    size = ~pmax(SD, 0.1)
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Visual Compare: Wired vs Wireless", x = 0.02),
      xaxis = list(title = "Average Latency (ms)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Same-Frame Probability (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.1),
      margin = list(t = 70, r = 20, b = 55, l = 70),
      hovermode = "closest",
      height = 460
    ) %>%
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      "function(el, x) {
        el.on('plotly_click', function(evt) {
          if (!evt || !evt.points || !evt.points.length) return;
          var slug = evt.points[0].customdata;
          if (slug && window.openControllerPage) {
            window.openControllerPage(slug);
          }
        });
      }"
    )

  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::tags$div(class = "bg-compare-note", "Scatter size reflects SD. Click a point to open that controller page."),
    htmltools::tags$div(id = "bg-visual-compare", class = "bg-visual-compare-wrap", p_buyer_scatter)
  )
}
```

```{r buyers-guide-js, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::HTML('
<script>
(function() {
  var THEME_KEY = "inputlatency-theme";
  var DENSITY_KEY = "inputlatency-density";
  var defaultState = { category: ["all"], connection: ["all"], platform: ["all"], face: ["all"], home: ["all"], analog: ["all"] };
  var state = { category: ["all"], connection: ["all"], platform: ["all"], face: ["all"], home: ["all"], analog: ["all"] };
  var activeControllerSlug = "";

  function normalize(x) {
    return (x || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function getControl(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }

  function getStoredTheme() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function getPreferredTheme() {
    var stored = getStoredTheme();
    if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark") {
      return stored;
    }
    return (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches) ? "dark" : "light";
  }

  function getStoredDensity() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem(DENSITY_KEY);
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function getPreferredDensity() {
    var density = getStoredDensity();
    return (density === "compact" || density === "comfortable") ? density : "comfortable";
  }

  function updateThemeButton(theme) {
    var btn = getControl("theme-toggle");
    if (!btn) return;
    if (theme === "dark") {
      btn.textContent = "Switch to Light";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Switch to light theme");
    } else {
      btn.textContent = "Switch to Dark";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Switch to dark theme");
    }
  }

  function updateDensityButton(density) {
    var btn = getControl("density-toggle");
    if (!btn) return;
    if (density === "compact") {
      btn.textContent = "Density: Compact";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Switch to comfortable density");
    } else {
      btn.textContent = "Density: Comfortable";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Switch to compact density");
    }
  }

  function applyPlotlyTheme(theme) {
    if (typeof window.inputLatencyRepaintPlots === "function") {
      window.inputLatencyRepaintPlots(document);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof Plotly === "undefined") return;
    var dark = theme === "dark";
    var baseLayout = {
      paper_bgcolor: dark ? "#151b29" : "#ffffff",
      plot_bgcolor: dark ? "#151b29" : "#ffffff",
      font: { color: dark ? "#e6edf8" : "#101622" }
    };
    document.querySelectorAll(".plotly-graph-div").forEach(function(el) {
      Plotly.relayout(el, baseLayout);
    });
  }

  function applyTheme(theme, persist) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
    updateThemeButton(theme);
    if (persist) {
      try { localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, theme); } catch (e) {}
    }
    applyPlotlyTheme(theme);
    if (typeof CustomEvent !== "undefined") {
      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("inputlatency:theme", { detail: { theme: theme } }));
    }
  }

  function applyDensity(density, persist) {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-density", density);
    updateDensityButton(density);
    if (persist) {
      try { localStorage.setItem(DENSITY_KEY, density); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  window.toggleTheme = function() {
    var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
    var next = current === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    applyTheme(next, true);
  };

  window.toggleDensity = function() {
    var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-density") || "comfortable";
    var next = current === "compact" ? "comfortable" : "compact";
    applyDensity(next, true);
  };

  function splitAttrValues(raw) {
    return String(raw || "")
      .split("|")
      .map(function(v) { return v.trim(); })
      .filter(function(v) { return v.length > 0; });
  }

  function matchesState(dim, values) {
    if (!state[dim] || state[dim].indexOf("all") >= 0) return true;
    if (!values || values.length === 0) return false;
    return state[dim].some(function(v) { return values.indexOf(v) >= 0; });
  }

  function getCardBySlug(slug) {
    if (!slug) return null;
    return document.querySelector(".bg-card[data-controller-slug=\\\"" + slug + "\\\"]");
  }

  function getBuyerScatterPlot() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById("bg-visual-compare");
    if (!wrap) return null;
    return wrap.querySelector(".plotly-graph-div");
  }

  function syncScatterToVisibleCards(visibleCards) {
    if (typeof Plotly === "undefined") return;
    var plot = getBuyerScatterPlot();
    if (!plot || !plot.data || !plot.data.length) return;
    var trace = plot.data[0];
    if (!trace || !Array.isArray(trace.customdata)) return;

    var visibleMap = {};
    visibleCards.forEach(function(card) {
      visibleMap[String(card.getAttribute("data-controller-slug") || "")] = true;
    });

    var opacity = trace.customdata.map(function(slug) {
      return visibleMap[String(slug)] ? 0.95 : 0.15;
    });
    Plotly.restyle(plot, { "marker.opacity": [opacity] }, [0]);
  }

  function buildDetailActions(card) {
    if (!card) return "";
    var rawHref = card.getAttribute("data-raw-target-href") || "#raw-data-deep-dive";
    var rawClick = card.getAttribute("data-raw-target-onclick") || "return openTabSection(\\\"raw-data-deep-dive\\\");";
    var rawText = card.getAttribute("data-raw-target-text") || "Open Raw Deep Dive";
    var controllerUrl = card.getAttribute("data-controller-url") || "";
    var buyUrl = card.getAttribute("data-buy-url") || "";

    var parts = [];
    parts.push("<a class=\\\"bg-detail-raw\\\" href=\\\"" + rawHref + "\\\" onclick=\\\"" + rawClick + "\\\">" + rawText + "</a>");
    if (controllerUrl) {
      parts.push("<a href=\\\"" + controllerUrl + "\\\" target=\\\"_blank\\\">Controller Link</a>");
    }
    if (buyUrl && buyUrl !== controllerUrl) {
      parts.push("<a href=\\\"" + buyUrl + "\\\" target=\\\"_blank\\\">Buy Link</a>");
    }
    return parts.join("");
  }

  function parseControllerSlug(id) {
    var m = String(id || "").match(/^controller-([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)$/);
    return m ? m[1] : "";
  }

  window.openControllerPage = function(slug, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var clean = String(slug || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, "");
    if (!clean) return false;

    var card = getCardBySlug(clean);
    if (!card) return false;

    showTabById("buyers-guide");
    activeControllerSlug = clean;

    var detailRoot = getControl("bg-controller-detail");
    var titleEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-title");
    var metaEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-meta");
    var actionsEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-actions");
    var bodyEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-body");
    var template = getControl("bg-controller-template-" + clean);
    if (!detailRoot || !titleEl || !metaEl || !actionsEl || !bodyEl || !template) return false;

    var nameEl = card.querySelector(".bg-card-name");
    var metricsEl = card.querySelector(".bg-card-metrics");
    var modeEl = card.querySelector(".bg-card-mode");
    var cat = card.getAttribute("data-category") || "";
    var conn = card.getAttribute("data-connection") || "";
    var face = splitAttrValues(card.getAttribute("data-face"));
    var home = splitAttrValues(card.getAttribute("data-home"));
    var analog = splitAttrValues(card.getAttribute("data-analog"));

    titleEl.textContent = nameEl ? nameEl.textContent : "Controller";
    var metaParts = [];
    if (metricsEl && metricsEl.textContent) metaParts.push(metricsEl.textContent);
    if (cat) metaParts.push(cat);
    if (conn) metaParts.push(conn);
    if (face.length > 0) metaParts.push("Face Buttons: " + face[0]);
    if (home.length > 0) metaParts.push("Home Button: " + home[0]);
    if (analog.length > 0) metaParts.push("Analog: " + analog[0]);
    if (modeEl && modeEl.textContent) metaParts.push(modeEl.textContent);
    metaEl.textContent = metaParts.join(" | ");

    actionsEl.innerHTML = buildDetailActions(card);
    bodyEl.innerHTML = template.innerHTML;
    detailRoot.hidden = false;

    if (window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === "function" && opts.updateHash !== false) {
      try {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "#controller-" + clean);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    window.setTimeout(function() {
      if (typeof detailRoot.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        detailRoot.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    }, 90);

    return false;
  };

  window.closeControllerPage = function() {
    activeControllerSlug = "";
    var detailRoot = getControl("bg-controller-detail");
    var titleEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-title");
    var metaEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-meta");
    var actionsEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-actions");
    var bodyEl = getControl("bg-controller-detail-body");
    if (detailRoot) detailRoot.hidden = true;
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = "";
    if (metaEl) metaEl.textContent = "";
    if (actionsEl) actionsEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (bodyEl) bodyEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === "function") {
      try {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "#buyers-guide");
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    return false;
  };

  function showTabById(id) {
    var links = document.querySelectorAll(".nav-tabs a");
    var link = null;
    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
      if (links[i].getAttribute("href") === "#" + id) {
        link = links[i];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!link) return;
    if (window.jQuery && typeof window.jQuery(link).tab === "function") {
      window.jQuery(link).tab("show");
    } else if (typeof link.click === "function") {
      link.click();
    }
  }

  function parseRawDistributionSlug(id) {
    var m = String(id || "").match(/^raw-dist-([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)$/);
    return m ? m[1] : "";
  }

  function getRawDistributionDeviceName(slug) {
    if (!slug) return "";
    var anchor = document.getElementById("raw-dist-" + slug);
    if (!anchor) return "";
    return String(anchor.getAttribute("data-raw-device") || "").trim();
  }

  function getRawDistributionPlot() {
    var section = document.getElementById("latency-distribution-by-device");
    if (!section) return null;
    return section.querySelector(".plotly-graph-div");
  }

  function setRawDistributionDevice(deviceName) {
    if (!deviceName || typeof Plotly === "undefined") return false;
    var plot = getRawDistributionPlot();
    if (!plot || !Array.isArray(plot.data) || plot.data.length === 0) return false;

    var idx = -1;
    for (var i = 0; i < plot.data.length; i++) {
      if (plot.data[i] && plot.data[i].name === deviceName) {
        idx = i;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (idx < 0) return false;

    var visibility = plot.data.map(function(_, traceIdx) {
      return traceIdx === idx;
    });
    Plotly.restyle(plot, "visible", visibility);

    if (plot.layout && Array.isArray(plot.layout.updatemenus) && plot.layout.updatemenus.length > 0) {
      var update = {};
      update["updatemenus[0].active"] = idx;
      Plotly.relayout(plot, update);
    }

    return true;
  }

  function scheduleRawDistributionFocus(slug) {
    if (!slug) return;
    var tries = 0;
    function attempt() {
      tries += 1;
      var deviceName = getRawDistributionDeviceName(slug);
      if (setRawDistributionDevice(deviceName)) return;
      if (tries < 12) {
        window.setTimeout(attempt, 160);
      }
    }
    window.setTimeout(attempt, 120);
  }

  window.openRawDistribution = function(slug) {
    var clean = String(slug || "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, "");
    if (!clean) {
      return window.openTabSection("latency-distribution-by-device");
    }
    window.openTabSection("raw-dist-" + clean);
    scheduleRawDistributionFocus(clean);
    return false;
  };

  window.openTabSection = function(targetId) {
    var id = String(targetId || "").replace(/^#/, "");
    if (!id) return true;

    var controllerSlug = parseControllerSlug(id);
    if (controllerSlug) {
      showTabById("buyers-guide");
      window.openControllerPage(controllerSlug, { updateHash: false });
      if (window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === "function") {
        try {
          window.history.replaceState(null, "", "#controller-" + controllerSlug);
        } catch (e) {
          window.location.hash = "controller-" + controllerSlug;
        }
      } else {
        window.location.hash = "controller-" + controllerSlug;
      }
      return false;
    }

    var rawSlug = parseRawDistributionSlug(id);
    var target = document.getElementById(id);
    if (rawSlug) {
      target = document.getElementById("latency-distribution-by-device") || target;
    }
    if (!target) return true;

    var ancestorIds = [];
    var node = target;
    while (node) {
      if (node.id) ancestorIds.unshift(node.id);
      node = node.parentElement;
    }
    ancestorIds.forEach(function(ancestorId) {
      showTabById(ancestorId);
    });

    if (window.history && typeof window.history.replaceState === "function") {
      try {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + id);
      } catch (e) {
        window.location.hash = id;
      }
    } else {
      window.location.hash = id;
    }

    window.setTimeout(function() {
      if (typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    }, 140);
    if (rawSlug) {
      scheduleRawDistributionFocus(rawSlug);
    }
    return false;
  };

  function sortCards(cards, sortBy) {
    function numAttr(card, key, fallback) {
      var val = parseFloat(card.getAttribute(key));
      return Number.isFinite(val) ? val : fallback;
    }

    cards.sort(function(a, b) {
      if (sortBy === "latency_desc") {
        return numAttr(b, "data-latency", -Infinity) - numAttr(a, "data-latency", -Infinity);
      }
      if (sortBy === "ontime_desc") {
        return numAttr(b, "data-ontime", -Infinity) - numAttr(a, "data-ontime", -Infinity);
      }
      if (sortBy === "price_asc") {
        return numAttr(a, "data-price", Infinity) - numAttr(b, "data-price", Infinity);
      }
      return numAttr(a, "data-latency", Infinity) - numAttr(b, "data-latency", Infinity);
    });
  }

  window.toggleFilter = function(dim, val, btn) {
    var btns = document.querySelectorAll(".filter-btn[data-dim=\'" + dim + "\']");
    btns.forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove("active"); });
    if (btn) btn.classList.add("active");
    state[dim] = [val];
    applyFilters();
  };

  window.resetFilters = function() {
    state = {
      category: defaultState.category.slice(),
      connection: defaultState.connection.slice(),
      platform: defaultState.platform.slice(),
      face: defaultState.face.slice(),
      home: defaultState.home.slice(),
      analog: defaultState.analog.slice()
    };

    ["category", "connection", "platform", "face", "home", "analog"].forEach(function(dim) {
      var btns = document.querySelectorAll(".filter-btn[data-dim=\'" + dim + "\']");
      btns.forEach(function(b) {
        b.classList.remove("active");
        if (b.getAttribute("data-val") === "all") {
          b.classList.add("active");
        }
      });
    });

    var search = getControl("bg-search");
    var sort = getControl("bg-sort");
    if (search) search.value = "";
    if (sort) sort.value = "latency_asc";

    applyFilters();
  };

  window.applyFilters = function() {
    var grid = document.getElementById("bg-card-grid");
    if (!grid) return;

    var cards = Array.prototype.slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll(".bg-card"));
    var total = cards.length;
    var shown = 0;
    var searchTerm = normalize(getControl("bg-search") ? getControl("bg-search").value : "");
    var sortBy = getControl("bg-sort") ? getControl("bg-sort").value : "latency_asc";
    var visibleCards = [];

    cards.forEach(function(card) {
      var catMatch = matchesState("category", [String(card.getAttribute("data-category") || "")]);
      var connMatch = matchesState("connection", [String(card.getAttribute("data-connection") || "")]);
      var faceMatch = matchesState("face", splitAttrValues(card.getAttribute("data-face")));
      var homeMatch = matchesState("home", splitAttrValues(card.getAttribute("data-home")));
      var analogMatch = matchesState("analog", splitAttrValues(card.getAttribute("data-analog")));
      var searchMatch = !searchTerm ||
                        normalize(card.getAttribute("data-search")).indexOf(searchTerm) >= 0;
      var platMatch = true;
      if (state.platform.indexOf("all") < 0) {
        var cardPlats = (card.getAttribute("data-platforms") || "").split(",").map(function(p) {
          return p.trim();
        }).filter(function(p) { return p.length > 0; });
        platMatch = state.platform.some(function(p) { return cardPlats.indexOf(p) >= 0; });
      }
      if (catMatch && connMatch && platMatch && faceMatch && homeMatch && analogMatch && searchMatch) {
        visibleCards.push(card);
      } else {
        card.style.display = "none";
      }
    });

    sortCards(visibleCards, sortBy);
    visibleCards.forEach(function(card, idx) {
      card.style.display = "";
      card.querySelector(".bg-card-rank").textContent = "#" + (idx + 1);
      card.style.setProperty("--stagger", String(idx % 12));
      card.style.animation = "none";
      card.offsetHeight;
      card.style.animation = "";
      grid.appendChild(card);
      shown++;
    });

    syncScatterToVisibleCards(visibleCards);
    if (activeControllerSlug) {
      var activeCard = getCardBySlug(activeControllerSlug);
      if (!activeCard || activeCard.style.display === "none") {
        window.closeControllerPage();
      }
    }

    var counter = document.getElementById("bg-counter");
    if (counter) {
      counter.textContent = "Showing " + shown + " of " + total + " devices";
    }
    var matchCounter = document.getElementById("bg-match-counter");
    if (matchCounter) {
      matchCounter.textContent = searchTerm ? "Search: \\"" + searchTerm + "\\"" : "";
    }
  };

  function bindControls() {
    var search = getControl("bg-search");
    var sort = getControl("bg-sort");
    if (search) search.addEventListener("input", applyFilters);
    if (sort) sort.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
  }

  function syncSystemThemeWhenUnpinned() {
    if (!window.matchMedia) return;
    var media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    var cb = function(e) {
      var stored = getStoredTheme();
      if (stored === "light" || stored === "dark") return;
      applyTheme(e.matches ? "dark" : "light", false);
    };
    if (media.addEventListener) {
      media.addEventListener("change", cb);
    } else if (media.addListener) {
      media.addListener(cb);
    }
  }

  var initialized = false;
  function initializeDashboard() {
    if (initialized) return;
    initialized = true;

    applyTheme(getPreferredTheme(), false);
    applyDensity(getPreferredDensity(), false);
    bindControls();
    applyFilters();
    syncSystemThemeWhenUnpinned();
    setTimeout(function() {
      applyPlotlyTheme(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light");
    }, 200);
    function openCurrentHash() {
      if (window.location && window.location.hash) {
        window.openTabSection(window.location.hash);
      }
    }
    setTimeout(openCurrentHash, 260);
    setTimeout(openCurrentHash, 700);
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeDashboard);
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function() {
    if (window.location && window.location.hash) {
      window.openTabSection(window.location.hash);
    }
  });

  if (document.readyState !== "loading") {
    initializeDashboard();
  }
})();
</script>
')
```

### Summary Statistics

```{r summary-stats, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Wired vs Wireless statistical comparison
wired_latency <- dat %>% filter(`Wired/Wireless` == "Wired") %>% pull(`Latency (in ms)`)
wireless_latency <- dat %>% filter(`Wired/Wireless` == "Wireless") %>% pull(`Latency (in ms)`)

if (length(wired_latency) > 2 && length(wireless_latency) > 2) {
  t_result <- t.test(wired_latency, wireless_latency)
}
```

**Overall Statistics:**

- Total devices tested: `r nrow(dat)`
- Wired devices: `r sum(dat$'Wired/Wireless' == "Wired", na.rm = TRUE)` (mean latency: `r round(mean(wired_latency, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` ms)
- Wireless devices: `r sum(dat$'Wired/Wireless' == "Wireless", na.rm = TRUE)` (mean latency: `r round(mean(wireless_latency, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` ms)
- Devices with raw capture backing: `r sum(dat$HasRawCapture, na.rm = TRUE)` (`r raw_coverage_pct`%)
- One frame threshold: `r round(100/6, 2)` ms (60 Hz)

```{r wired-wireless-ttest, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (exists("t_result")) {
  cat(sprintf("\n**Wired vs Wireless t-test:** t = %.2f, p-value = %.4f %s\n",
              t_result$statistic,
              t_result$p.value,
              ifelse(t_result$p.value < 0.05, "(statistically significant)", "(not significant)")))
}
```


```{r raw-histogram-interactive, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (nrow(raw_data) > 0) {
  # Get all devices sorted by mean latency
  device_list <- raw_stats %>%
    arrange(RawMean) %>%
    pull(Device)

  # Pre-bin histograms to reduce page size vs embedding full raw vectors
  max_delay <- max(raw_data$delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  hist_breaks <- seq(0, max(40, ceiling(max_delay)), by = 0.5)
  hist_cache <- lapply(device_list, function(dev) {
    dev_delay <- raw_data %>% filter(Device == dev) %>% pull(delay)
    h <- hist(dev_delay, breaks = hist_breaks, plot = FALSE)
    tibble::tibble(mid = h$mids, count = h$counts)
  })

  # Create dropdown buttons
  buttons <- lapply(seq_along(device_list), function(i) {
    visibility <- rep(FALSE, length(device_list))
    visibility[i] <- TRUE
    list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(list(visible = visibility)),
      label = truncate_name(device_list[i], 50)
    )
  })

  # Combine all traces
  p_hist <- plot_ly()
  for (i in seq_along(device_list)) {
    hdat <- hist_cache[[i]]
    p_hist <- p_hist %>%
      add_bars(
        x = hdat$mid,
        y = hdat$count,
        name = device_list[i],
        visible = (i == 1),
        marker = list(color = '#3498DB')
      )
  }

  p_hist %>%
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Latency Distribution", y = 0.95),
      xaxis = list(title = "Latency (ms)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Count"),
      showlegend = FALSE,
      shapes = list(
        list(type = "line", x0 = 100/6, x1 = 100/6, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
             yref = "paper", line = list(color = "#BA1B1D", dash = "dash", width = 2))
      ),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          active = 0,
          buttons = buttons,
          x = 0.0,
          xanchor = "left",
          y = 1.15,
          yanchor = "top"
        )
      ),
      annotations = list(
        list(text = "Select Device:", x = 0, xref = "paper", xanchor = "left",
             y = 1.22, yref = "paper", showarrow = FALSE)
      ),
      margin = list(t = 100)
    )
}
```

#### Time-Series Pattern Viewer

Select a device to view its latency over time. Look for periodic sawtooth patterns indicating polling intervals.

```{r raw-timeseries-interactive, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (nrow(raw_data) > 0) {
  downsample_device_series <- function(df, max_points = 300) {
    if (nrow(df) <= max_points) {
      return(df)
    }
    idx <- unique(round(seq(1, nrow(df), length.out = max_points)))
    df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # Get devices with at least 100 readings (cap count for page size)
  devices_with_data <- raw_data %>%
    count(Device) %>%
    filter(n >= 100) %>%
    arrange(desc(n), Device) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    pull(Device)

  # Create dropdown buttons
  buttons_ts <- lapply(seq_along(devices_with_data), function(i) {
    visibility <- rep(FALSE, length(devices_with_data))
    visibility[i] <- TRUE
    list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(list(visible = visibility)),
      label = truncate_name(devices_with_data[i], 50)
    )
  })

  # Build plot with all device traces
  p_ts <- plot_ly()
  for (i in seq_along(devices_with_data)) {
    dev_data <- raw_data %>%
      filter(Device == devices_with_data[i]) %>%
      arrange(read) %>%
      downsample_device_series(max_points = 300)

    p_ts <- p_ts %>%
      add_trace(x = dev_data$read, y = dev_data$delay,
                type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers',
                name = devices_with_data[i],
                visible = (i == 1),
                line = list(color = '#3498DB', width = 1),
                marker = list(color = '#3498DB', size = 3))
  }

  p_ts %>%
    layout(
      title = list(text = "Latency Time Series (Downsampled to 300 Points)", y = 0.95),
      xaxis = list(title = "Reading Number"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Latency (ms)"),
      showlegend = FALSE,
      shapes = list(
        list(type = "line", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, xref = "paper",
             y0 = 100/6, y1 = 100/6,
             line = list(color = "#BA1B1D", dash = "dash", width = 2))
      ),
      updatemenus = list(
        list(
          type = "dropdown",
          active = 0,
          buttons = buttons_ts,
          x = 0.0,
          xanchor = "left",
          y = 1.15,
          yanchor = "top"
        )
      ),
      annotations = list(
        list(text = "Select Device:", x = 0, xref = "paper", xanchor = "left",
             y = 1.22, yref = "paper", showarrow = FALSE)
      ),
      margin = list(t = 100),
      height = 500
    )
}
```

#### Consistency Analysis

Devices with higher consistency scores have more predictable latency (less variance relative to mean).

```{r consistency-plotly, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, warning=FALSE}

    labs(title = "Latency vs Consistency",

          axis.title = element_text(size = 11))

  ggplotly(p_consistency, tooltip = c("text", "x", "y"), width = 1200, height = 500) %>%

}
```

### Latency Ranges

These plots show approximate latency ranges using 95% confidence intervals. Due to limited data, some standard deviations were imputed using linear regression. Imputed values are shown in a different color.

Use the filters below to show specific device types and connection methods.

```{r latency-range-filters, echo=FALSE}

  mutate(

    DeviceShort = truncate_name(DeviceLabel, 45)
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Latency (in ms)`) %>%
  mutate(DeviceShort = factor(DeviceShort, levels = rev(unique(DeviceShort))))

# Use a named key so filters and plot share the same crosstalk group

bscols(widths = c(12),
  list(
    filter_select("ConnectionType", "Wired/Wireless", shared_range_dat, ~`Wired/Wireless`, multiple = TRUE),
```

```{r latency-range-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.height=25, fig.width=14, warning=FALSE}
# Build native plot_ly so crosstalk filters work
p_range <- plot_ly(height = plot_height, width = 1400) %>%
  # Error bars for imputed SD
  add_trace(data = shared_imputed,
            x = ~`Latency (in ms)`, y = ~DeviceShort,

              type = "data",

            ),
```
