```{r latency-range-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.height=25, fig.width=14, warning=FALSE}
  # Error bars for measured SD
  add_trace(data = shared_measured,
            x = ~`Latency (in ms)`, y = ~DeviceShort,
            type = 'scatter', mode = 'markers',
            error_x = list(
              type = "data",
              symmetric = FALSE,
              array = ~(`SD up` - `Latency (in ms)`),
              arrayminus = ~(`Latency (in ms)` - `SD down`),
              color = "#457B9D", width = 3
            ),
            marker = list(color = "#333", size = 6),
            name = "Measured SD",
            hovertext = ~paste0(DeviceLabel,
                               "\nLatency: ", round(`Latency (in ms)`, 2), " ms",
                               "\nCategory: ", Category,
                               "\nConnection: ", `Wired/Wireless`),
            hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Device Latency Ranges (95% CI)<br><sup>Sorted by average latency (lowest first)</sup>"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Latency (ms)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", tickfont = list(size = 7)),
    hovermode = "closest",
    margin = list(l = 280, t = 80, b = 80),
    shapes = list(
      list(type = "line", x0 = 100/6, x1 = 100/6, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
           yref = "paper", line = list(color = "#BA1B1D", dash = "dash", width = 2))
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.05)
  )

p_range
```

<small>**Note:** Red error bars indicate imputed standard deviation (estimated via linear regression). Blue bars are measured values.</small>

### Best Performers by Category

Top 3 performing devices in each category, separated by wired and wireless connection.

```{r best-performers, echo=FALSE}
# Get top 3 wired devices per category
best_wired <- dat %>%
  filter(`Wired/Wireless` == "Wired", !is.na(Category)) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_min(`Latency (in ms)`, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%

  group_by(Category) %>%
  slice_min(`Latency (in ms)`, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Connection = "Wireless") %>%
  select(Category, Connection, Rank, Device = DeviceClean, `Latency (in ms)`)

# Combine and arrange
best_performers <- bind_rows(best_wired, best_wireless) %>%
  arrange(Category, Connection, Rank) %>%
  mutate(
    `Latency (in ms)` = round(`Latency (in ms)`, 2),

datatable(best_performers,
          options = list(

            )
          ),
          filter = 'top',
          rownames = FALSE,
          caption = "Top 3 devices per category and connection type (lowest latency)")
```

### Methodology

This data was collected using a closed-loop latency testing system consisting of:

- **Arduino Pro Micro** - Triggers virtual button presses and measures response time via hardware interrupt
- **DE10-nano with MiSTer FPGA** - Running the NES Lag Tester core to detect inputs
- **Custom test PCB** - Connects the Arduino, controller pins, and DE10-nano

The Arduino triggers a button press on the controller under test, and measures the time until the MiSTer core detects the input. Results are captured via serial output in CSV format.

For more details, see the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/misteraddons/inputlatency).

```{r plotly-resize-handler, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::HTML('
<script>
function inputLatencyPlotlyStyle(theme) {
  var dark = theme === "dark";
  return {
    paperBg: dark ? "#151b29" : "#ffffff",
    plotBg: dark ? "#151b29" : "#ffffff",
    fontColor: dark ? "#e6edf8" : "#101622",
    gridColor: dark ? "rgba(186, 204, 235, 0.18)" : "rgba(31, 53, 91, 0.15)",
    zeroColor: dark ? "rgba(186, 204, 235, 0.26)" : "rgba(31, 53, 91, 0.25)",
    legendBg: dark ? "rgba(18, 24, 35, 0.6)" : "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)",
    hoverBg: dark ? "rgba(20, 27, 40, 0.95)" : "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)",
    hoverBorder: dark ? "rgba(200, 181, 255, 0.36)" : "rgba(80, 0, 220, 0.26)",
    colorway: dark
      ? ["#b99eff", "#E6FF1E", "#8f69ff", "#d3eb42", "#ff95c7", "#8ec3ff"]
      : ["#5000DC", "#A2B800", "#6f2cff", "#c3d900", "#af4eff", "#3e4870"]
  };
}

function inputLatencyLayoutPatch(node, style) {
  var patch = {
    paper_bgcolor: style.paperBg,
    plot_bgcolor: style.plotBg,
    "font.color": style.fontColor,
    "legend.font.color": style.fontColor,
    "legend.bgcolor": style.legendBg,
    "legend.bordercolor": style.gridColor,
    "hoverlabel.bgcolor": style.hoverBg,
    "hoverlabel.bordercolor": style.hoverBorder,
    "hoverlabel.font.color": style.fontColor,
    colorway: style.colorway
  };

  var full = node && node._fullLayout ? node._fullLayout : {};
  Object.keys(full).forEach(function(key) {
    if (!/^xaxis\\d*$/.test(key) && !/^yaxis\\d*$/.test(key)) return;
    patch[key + ".gridcolor"] = style.gridColor;
    patch[key + ".linecolor"] = style.gridColor;
    patch[key + ".tickcolor"] = style.gridColor;
    patch[key + ".zerolinecolor"] = style.zeroColor;
    patch[key + ".tickfont.color"] = style.fontColor;
    patch[key + ".title.font.color"] = style.fontColor;
  });

  return patch;
}

function inputLatencyRepaintPlots(scope) {
  if (typeof Plotly === "undefined") return;
  var theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") || "light";
  var style = inputLatencyPlotlyStyle(theme);
  var root = scope || document;
  var nodes = root.querySelectorAll ? root.querySelectorAll(".plotly-graph-div") : [];
  nodes.forEach(function(node) {
    var patch = inputLatencyLayoutPatch(node, style);
    Plotly.Plots.resize(node);
    Plotly.relayout(node, patch);
  });
}

window.inputLatencyRepaintPlots = inputLatencyRepaintPlots;
window.inputLatencyPlotlyStyle = inputLatencyPlotlyStyle;

// Resize and retheme Plotly/DataTables when switching tabs
$(document).on("shown.bs.tab", "a[data-toggle=\'tab\']", function() {
  var pane = $($(this).attr("href"));
  inputLatencyRepaintPlots(pane.get(0));
});

// Keep hidden charts synced with theme changes
document.addEventListener("inputlatency:theme", function() {
  inputLatencyRepaintPlots(document);
});
</script>
```
